integrity: Mathematical proof accompanied by exact-rational algebra checks; no independent scientific audit or validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic rather than finite-resolution inference, ideal complete coefficient access, not robust to unknown frequency-dependent spectral shape or correlated subordinator components; normal limit conditional on the clock. Generic gamma moment formulas and conventional gamma estimation are prior knowledge.
scientific_scope: Noiseless full-sky real spherical harmonic coefficients of all positive degrees; known positive summable spectral shape; fixed known gamma-subordinator shape rate parameters; positive-density integrable shared random clock; unknown deterministic amplitude.
title: A single-sky identifiability dichotomy for gamma-clock and global-clock grey spherical fields
